text: With the ledger and Accounts Payable built, Theo Branagh turns to security -- who at Stonefield can create, view, and approve what.
Arjun Mehta, Felicity Dunmore, and Simone Alvarez each get a manager-level job role, scoped to their own team's work.
Underneath every job role sit duty roles. Specialists can enter and manage invoices, but only a manager can approve one or release a payment.
Every assignment is scoped to Stonefield Distribution Inc.'s Business Unit and the Stonefield Primary Ledger -- and Elena Marchetti gets full visibility with no transaction access at all.
Security is built. Next, the team runs a full dry-run close before any real transaction ever hits the system.
